title: fix(components): give the Dialog close button a 44 px touch target at phone width
body:
domain:ui#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRFuJz9QBZqPVHYVhJ

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCP1P1FEnhJ4Bx9RmczEwBK)_

Fixes #29107

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:手机宽度(小于 sm 断点)下,所有弹窗右上角的关闭按钮从 16×16 px 的点击区扩大到 44×44 px,图标本身仍是 16 px;桌面宽度下按钮样式一字未改。
- **为什么改**:移动端 App 用 WebView 承载 Console,手机用户打开的每个弹窗(操作参数弹窗如审批「驳回」、命令面板 ⌘K 等)都用这一个共享 Dialog,关闭按钮太小、经常点不中。
- **风险与回滚**:只加了 `max-sm:` 前缀的样式类,桌面不受影响;图标在手机上向内移动 2 px(距角 17 px → 19 px)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`(新增的 `phoneCloseTouchTargetPatches` 补丁声明)、`ui/packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx`(Close 那一行)、`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-close-touch-target-29107.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-close-touch-target-29107.test.tsx scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`,预期全绿;或在 375 px 宽的 Console 里按 Ctrl+K,关闭按钮的点击区是 44×44。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- The close button `DialogContent` draws in its top-right corner gets a phone-only touch target: below `sm` it is a 44 x 44 px flex box placed 4 px from the corner with the 16 px glyph centred (`max-sm:right-1 max-sm:top-1 max-sm:flex max-sm:size-11 max-sm:items-center max-sm:justify-center`, the class set #29078 uses for the Sheet close). From `sm` up the class list is upstream's, token for token, so the desktop header does not grow.
- `dialog.tsx` is a Shadcn-synced file (`ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 7), so the change is declared as a local patch, `phoneCloseTouchTargetPatches('Dialog')` in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, anchored on the opening of the Close element's class list as the vendored registry fixture spells it. The shipped `dialog.tsx` line was written by applying that patch to the file, so `REGISTRY_FIXTURES.dialog` keeps its byte round trip (`roundTrip: true`) and the next `pnpm shadcn:update` re-applies it instead of reverting it. The helper takes the Radix prefix, so the Sheet close can take the same family.
- Both sites the card names render `DialogContent`'s own close: the declared-action param dialog (`ActionParamDialog`, e.g. the `sys_approval_request` Reject decision) and the command palette (`CommandDialog`).
- `ui/packages/components/shadcn-components.json`: dialog's `localEdits` note now names the phone close touch-target patch beside the i18n close patch (claim amendment 6573487904).
- Changeset `.changeset/29107-dialog-close-phone-touch-target.md`: `@object-ui/components` patch.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-close-touch-target-29107.test.tsx`: on `DialogContent` and on `CommandDialog`, the Close carries the six phone classes, every class without the `max-sm:` prefix equals upstream's list in order, and the glyph keeps `h-4 w-4`.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: the dialog declares the new patch id; applied to the registry bytes it adds the phone classes and leaves upstream's Close classes unchanged; it refuses (only that patch, the close-label family still lands) when upstream moves the Close off `right-4 top-4`. The two close-label counts on dialog are scoped to their own family.
- Ablation, one-shot, at 20e48bf1: with `dialog.tsx` restored to main's bytes (tree only, restored from HEAD afterwards, `git status` clean), 4 cases go red: both new component cases, "dialog.tsx carries its declared patches" and "dialog: byte round-trip holds".

## Acceptance notes

- The glyph moves 2 px on phones: it sat 17 px from the dialog's top-right edge (16 px placement plus the 1 px border) and now sits 19 px (4 px placement + 1 px border + 14 px centring inside 44 px). That is the cost of matching #29078's class set; `max-sm:right-0.5 max-sm:top-0.5` would keep it at 17 px.
- The 2 px glyph shift above is accepted by the seat: it keeps the Dialog and Sheet class sets identical.
- `sheet.tsx`'s close is #29078's; `REGISTRY_FIXTURES.sheet` is `roundTrip: true` as well, so a bare class edit there reds "sheet: byte round-trip holds" unless it is declared the same way.

## Verification

- Real browser, showcase backend plus the Console Vite dev server, Playwright at 375 x 812 and 1280 x 800, measuring the dialog element's own Close (screenshots and the script stay in the project files, not here):
  - Before (main's `dialog.tsx`): param dialog and command palette Close are 16 x 16 px at 375 px and at 1280 px.
  - After: 44 x 44 px at 375 px on both sites, glyph 16 x 16; at 1280 px both are still 16 x 16 px at the same position.
- Local gates at 20e48bf1: the 36 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff all exit 0 (`--ran` reconciliation: 36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED), including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files, 4903 tests passed). `@object-ui/components` type-check (including `tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0; eslint on the four touched source files exit 0; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 new.
- After merging main (d0c0addd, no main commit touches these files): the three touched test files re-run green (66 tests).
- At cc550d3e (the `localEdits` note): the same 36 derived families; the files that read `shadcn-components.json` plus the patch and dialog tests re-run green (5 files, 92 tests), `check:published-files`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
- At 1855aa32: `snapshot-critical.test.tsx` ("Dialog snapshots > renders open dialog structure", red in Test UI 10/16 on cc550d3e) regenerated with `vitest --update`; the `.snap` diff is the Close line only, gaining the six `max-sm:` classes. A sweep of every `*.snap`, `*.test.*` and `*.spec.*` file for the Close class list (`right-4 top-4 rounded-sm`, `rounded-sm opacity-70`, `data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-muted-foreground`) finds no other pin. The snapshot file and the dialog test re-run green (2 files, 22 tests); the whole components package did not finish locally within 560 s, so CI Test UI carries it.
